question: What changed after the decision to freeze an interface, and how much churn followed?
sql:
WITH freeze AS (
  SELECT MIN(authored_date) AS freeze_date
  FROM v_commit
  WHERE subject ILIKE '%freeze%' AND subject ILIKE '%interface%'
)
SELECT
  c.commit_sha,
  c.authored_date,
  c.contributor,
  c.subject,
  c.touched_components,
  (c.insertions + c.deletions) AS churn
FROM v_commit c, freeze f
WHERE f.freeze_date IS NOT NULL AND c.authored_date > f.freeze_date
ORDER BY c.authored_date
